scripts.predev: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Remove-Item -LiteralPath public/sw.js -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Path public/workbox-*.js -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
scripts.test:rules: node scripts/test-env.mjs node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/bin/firebase.js emulators:exec --project demo-keepl --only firestore "tsx --test tests/firebase/*.test.ts"
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/test-env.mjs node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/bin/firebase.js emulators:exec --project demo-keepl --only auth,firestore "playwright test"
scripts.test:benchmark: node scripts/test-env.mjs node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/bin/firebase.js emulators:exec --project demo-keepl --only firestore "tsx tests/firebase/benchmark.ts"
